name: Tanjiro Kamado
summary: After Muzan Kibutsuji's death, Tanjiro was transformed into a demon after receiving all of Muzan's remaining power. In this state, he was considered the new strongest demon after Muzan and possessed immense physical power, regeneration, and resistance to the weaknesses normally associated with demons. His consciousness was overwhelmed by Muzan's final will, leaving him driven to eradicate the Demon Slayer Corps until Nezuko, Kanao, and his friends reached him.

stats.range: Extended Melee Range, Tens of Meters with Shockwaves, Tendrils and Energy Projection

weaknesses: Wisteria flowers are poisonous to him
notes: Tanjiro's Demon Form key. He was infused with all of Muzan's remaining power and was considered the new strongest demon after Muzan. His demonic physiology grants extremely powerful regeneration and makes him exceptionally difficult to kill. He was eventually restored to human form through the combined efforts of Kanao, Nezuko, and the Demon Slayers.
